questions.q: What does Deutscher suggest about language difficulty and a learner's native tongue?
a: It depends on the learner's existing languages
questions.why: Deutscher notes difficulty varies with languages you already speak.

questions.q: How do grammatical structures influence thought, according to the book?
a: They shape the concepts we must express
They have no effect on cognition
questions.why: The text says rules change requirements of words and thus affect thinking.

questions.q: What linguistic feature does Hebrew lack that English has?
questions.why: Hebrew expresses rain as "the rain falls" without a verb for raining.

questions.q: Which language assigns three gender categories to nouns?
questions.why: German has masculine, feminine, and neuter noun markers.

questions.q: What did Toshi Konishi find about adjective choice for bridges?
questions.why: Study showed descriptions aligned with the gender assigned to "bridge".
